# amisearchable.cc

> Free AI crawler checker. Paste a domain to see if GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, and other AI search bots are blocked in robots.txt. Embed an AI-Search Ready badge in a README or footer.

This site is open to AI search and training crawlers, including GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, and CCBot.

## Product

- [Check a domain](https://amisearchable.cc/): AI crawler access checker for robots.txt and llms.txt
- [Pricing](https://amisearchable.cc/pricing): Free badge, Pro monitoring for status changes
- [Guides](https://amisearchable.cc/guides): GEO, AEO, and AI search visibility explainers
- [Privacy Policy](https://amisearchable.cc/privacy)
- [Terms of Service](https://amisearchable.cc/terms)
- [Our robots.txt](https://amisearchable.cc/robots.txt)
- [This file](https://amisearchable.cc/llms.txt)
- [Full description](https://amisearchable.cc/llms-full.txt)

## Guides

- [GPTBot vs ChatGPT-User vs OAI-SearchBot](https://amisearchable.cc/guides/gptbot-vs-chatgpt-user): Training vs live fetch vs ChatGPT search
- [Does blocking AI crawlers hurt Google ranking?](https://amisearchable.cc/guides/does-blocking-ai-crawlers-hurt-google): Googlebot and Google-Extended are separate
- [AI crawler user agents (2026)](https://amisearchable.cc/guides/ai-crawler-user-agents): The bot list this product actually checks
- [llms.txt explained](https://amisearchable.cc/guides/llms-txt): What the file is and whether you need one
- [llms.txt vs robots.txt](https://amisearchable.cc/guides/llms-txt-vs-robots-txt): Complementary files, different jobs
- [How to allow PerplexityBot](https://amisearchable.cc/guides/how-to-allow-perplexitybot): Paste-ready robots.txt rules
- [AI ready badge](https://amisearchable.cc/guides/ai-ready-badge): Embeddable AI crawler status badge for READMEs
